data.description: Collect customer preferences via RCS messaging using quick-reply buttons, and send personalized product recommendations based on their responses. Engage customers in real time, gather relevant data, and automate the entire experience.
data.name: RCS Interactive Product Recommendation Flow

template.callout: Deliver personalized product recommendations at scale while capturing valuable customer insights leveraging the RCS messaging.
